verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a self-hosted library that stores user data in your own database (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and more), so you decide where that data lives by choosing where to host the database. Community users confirm they keep all auth data in their own DB and are not tied to any provider. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation on data residency or region selection, and coverage of where any vendor-hosted components store data.
